input.prompt: Straight-on front view, camera exactly square to it: a wide rectangular circuit-board module in the same style as the references, filling most of the picture with a little deep black void around it. On its left third, a large thick gold coin set flat into a round gold socket on the board, its face completely smooth and blank. On the right two thirds, FIVE long thin horizontal bar-graph windows stacked one above the other with even spacing, all exactly the same length and height, left edges aligned, each window a slot of blank dark smoked glass framed by a thin polished gold bezel with rounded ends; the top window sits slightly apart from the four below it, separated by a thin gold trace line. The windows are empty and unlit. Green circuit board with fine gold traces and tiny SMD parts around them, the area just right of each window left plain and clear. Edges straight and parallel to the picture's edges. Painted American comic book art of hardware: sharp clean black ink outlines, modelled 3D form, one warm golden key light from above, a green rim light on the left edge and a red rim light on the right edge, comic halftone dots only inside the shadows, palette black, dark green, red and gold. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no labels, no silkscreen markings, no scale markings.
